_what_we_learn: Does adding 'why it matters' improve or clutter the beat?

beats.line: When an agent process starts, it has no way to prove what it is.
To fix that, the platform runs a workload certificate authority — an independent source of truth about process identity.
Before the first user request ever arrives, the CA signs a short-lived credential for that specific process.
From that point on, every downstream call the agent makes carries that credential as proof of who it is.
This matters because it separates the agent's identity from the identity of whoever triggered it.
